# which-pr-finds-most-recent-add

which_pr_introduced selects the most recent DeltaChangeRow with op == 'added' for the given slug (ordered by DeltaChangeRow.id desc, limit 1) and reports run.pr_number; if pr_number is None it sets a 'full-compile bootstrap' note.

Attribute an entity's introduction to the latest 'added' delta, and mark cases where no PR attribution exists (e.g. full-compile bootstrap).
